review.en: Hikaru Utada was sixteen when this debut came out, and it became the best-selling album in Japanese history. The songs bring the phrasing of American R&B into Japanese pop with an ease few had managed, and the title ballad has stayed in the culture for a generation. Some of the production belongs to its year; the writing and the voice do not.
review.zh: 宇多田光发行这张出道专辑时只有十六岁，它成了日本史上销量最高的专辑。这些歌把美国节奏布鲁斯的唱腔自然地带进日语流行乐，此前少有人做得这样从容；同名抒情曲在一代人的记忆里一直没有退场。部分制作带着那个年份的痕迹，写作和嗓音却没有。
